title: Prax Teach v2 — Zero-API Visual Runtime Upgrade

claim_policy.engineering_complete: All engineering criteria ZV-00 through ZV-35 are verified on one exact clean HEAD.
claim_policy.scientifically_complete: Engineering complete plus EG-ZV-01 through EG-ZV-04 verified from genuine external observations.
forbidden_substitutions: Synthetic learner data for human outcomes
Automated accessibility checks for field accessibility
A planned delay for an elapsed 7–14 day measurement

criteria.title: Freeze and inventory current candidate
criteria.acceptance: Record absolute root, branch, HEAD, dirty state, toolchain, existing runtime boundary, relevant tests, and source hashes before modification.

criteria.title: Approve runtime-boundary ADR
criteria.acceptance: ADR preserves the bundled static renderer, creates a separately versioned local runtime, defines fail-closed routing, and documents rollback.

criteria.title: Enforce no-API and no-network architecture
criteria.acceptance: Contract, CSP, allowlist, and automated interception fail on telemetry, remote assets, provider SDKs, API-key paths, or any runtime request.

criteria.title: Add capability-adaptive execution policy
criteria.acceptance: Core policy is harness-neutral, separates capability from authorization, bounds delegation and quota, preserves primary ownership, and has single-agent fallback.

criteria.title: Define lesson and learning-receipt schemas
criteria.acceptance: Versioned schemas, positive/negative fixtures, canonical serialization, import validation, and forward-incompatibility behavior pass.

criteria.title: Freeze static baseline and comparison protocol
criteria.acceptance: Current static lesson behavior, hashes, task script, outcome measures, exclusions, and hard failures are frozen before pilot construction.

criteria.title: Scaffold independently versioned runtime
criteria.acceptance: Local package has pinned project-scoped dependencies, deterministic scripts, no remote runtime dependency, and a documented public boundary.

criteria.title: Implement accessible state-stepper
criteria.acceptance: Previous, next, jump, reset, keyboard, focus, announcements, stable state IDs, property tests, and complete static sequence pass.

criteria.title: Implement local receipt panel
criteria.acceptance: Preview, copy, download, validated import, corruption isolation, delete, privacy copy, and round-trip tests pass without automatic transfer.

criteria.title: Implement ordered hint state
criteria.acceptance: One next-needed level is exposed only after an attempt; order, reset, receipt capture, and answer-leakage fixtures pass.

criteria.title: Build Python floating-point pilot
criteria.acceptance: Prediction, construction, comparison, rounding, explanation, unfamiliar transfer, and receipt sequence works from one validated lesson spec.

criteria.title: Preserve static, no-script, print, and reduced-motion routes
criteria.acceptance: Essential meaning and learner sequence remain complete with JavaScript off, motion reduced, printing, and runtime absence; router fails closed accurately.

criteria.title: Pass pilot browser, accessibility, privacy, and security gates
criteria.acceptance: Recorded browser matrix, keyboard route, zoom/reflow, CSP, no-network interception, injection fixtures, storage inspection, and accessibility engineering checks pass.

criteria.title: Pilot independent review and stop/go decision
criteria.acceptance: Exact-byte code, architecture, learning-design, accessibility, privacy, and claim reviews close all high findings and record an explicit MVP go/no-go.

criteria.title: Implement parameter-lab
criteria.acceptance: Labeled native controls, exact values, announced results, valid ranges, reset, keyboard operation, property tests, and static samples pass.

criteria.title: Implement compare-views
criteria.acceptance: Synchronized selection and explicit mappings across views have semantic table/text equivalents and never rely on color alone.

criteria.title: Harden shared hint engine and deterministic graders
criteria.acceptance: Hint state is reusable; exact/structural grading limits are explicit; ambiguous natural language routes to host tutor rather than false certainty.

criteria.title: Add deterministic lesson builder and manifest
criteria.acceptance: Validated spec-to-artifact builds are reproducible, content-addressed, source-mapped, CSP-bound, and reject unsupported components or versions.

criteria.title: Build Rubik’s move laboratory
criteria.acceptance: Legal-state manipulation, notation/permutation/spatial comparison, novel transfer, cube invariants, receipt, and static route pass without core forks.

criteria.title: Build lost-update laboratory
criteria.acceptance: Learner-controlled interleavings, synchronized timeline/state table, race diagnosis, unfamiliar transfer, schedule properties, receipt, and static route pass.

criteria.title: Prove runtime reuse across three domains
criteria.acceptance: Three lesson specs use shared public components without lesson-specific core branches; differences remain data or bounded adapters.

criteria.title: Pass full MVP verification
criteria.acceptance: Focused, full, property, integration, browser, accessibility, privacy, security, no-network, deterministic-build, and independent review gates pass on exact bytes.

criteria.title: Approve one-experiment Lean ADR
criteria.acceptance: ADR names the learning claim, why Lean fits, pinned boundary, costs, success threshold, stop rule, browser exclusion, and removal path.

criteria.title: Implement pinned build-time Lean adapter
criteria.acceptance: Pinned local verifier emits validated proof states and a formal receipt binding version, imports, axioms, warnings, source hash, and result.

criteria.title: Build proof-state lesson with static equivalent
criteria.acceptance: Preverified proof states render through shared components, remain intelligible in static form, and never imply a live browser theorem prover.

criteria.title: Make evidence-based Lean keep-or-revert decision
criteria.acceptance: Measured correctness/learning value is weighed against authoring, build, maintenance, accessibility, and cognitive cost; adapter is explicitly kept or cleanly removed.

criteria.title: Predeclare evaluation protocol
criteria.acceptance: Frozen comparison, hypotheses, outcomes, exclusions, sample rationale, stopping rules, uncertainty, hard failures, and claim language exist before observations.

criteria.title: Implement evaluation capture and analysis
criteria.acceptance: Randomization where applicable, pseudonymous local capture, validation, exclusion logging, analysis, confidence/uncertainty, and immutable receipts pass on synthetic fixtures.

criteria.title: Prepare representative accessibility field protocol
criteria.acceptance: Keyboard, zoom, reduced motion, assistive technology, consent, task script, issue severity, and evidence-capture protocol are ready without claiming field passage.

criteria.title: Prepare immediate, delayed, and transfer study operations
criteria.acceptance: Recruitment boundary, consent, scheduling, instruments, receipt handling, dropout rules, analysis commands, and no-fabrication guard are executable.

criteria.title: Representative accessibility field evidence
criteria.acceptance: Real representative users complete critical tasks with recorded accessibility evidence; hard failures are absent or remediated and retested.

criteria.title: Immediate learner-outcome evidence
criteria.acceptance: Real learners provide predeclared retrieval, explanation, application, discrimination, transfer, cognitive-load, agency, and trust observations.

criteria.title: Delayed 7–14 day retention evidence
criteria.acceptance: The declared interval actually elapses and real learners complete unassisted delayed retrieval and explanation under the frozen protocol.

criteria.title: Novel-transfer and generalization evidence
criteria.acceptance: Real delayed participants solve predeclared unfamiliar cases and results support only the bounded claim allowed by the protocol.

criteria.title: Gate optional SkillOpt, Flint, and future adapters
criteria.acceptance: Optional integrations remain off by default; each has a named job, frozen baseline, hard gates, cost boundary, fallback, and keep/reject decision.

criteria.title: Synchronize canonical documentation and HTML
criteria.acceptance: All durable Markdown has exact generated HTML companions with source path/hash, accessible structure, print/reduced-motion support, and no stale claims.

criteria.title: Run independent code and architecture review
criteria.acceptance: Bounded independent reviews inspect exact payload, criteria, architecture, security/privacy, accessibility, pedagogy, and claims; all critical/high findings close.

criteria.title: Run clean-room full verification
criteria.acceptance: A clean environment recomputes focused and full tests, builds, hashes, CSP/no-network gates, browser checks, schemas, manifests, and documentation parity.

criteria.title: Create immutable candidate package and rollback receipt
criteria.acceptance: Clean-HEAD package, inventory, hashes, SBOM/dependency record, verification receipt, known limits, static rollback, and restore instructions bind the same bytes.

criteria.title: Issue truthful completion and promotion handoff
criteria.acceptance: Handoff distinguishes engineering from scientific state, lists parked gates, provides exact commands/paths/hashes, and requests approval before merge, push, deploy, or canonical install.
